versions.content: If a data element has been received invalidated in case of Inter- ECU communication and the attribute handleInvalid is set to dontInvalidate  the query of the value shall return the value provided by COM. Then the reception will be handled as if a valid value would have been received (activation of runnable entities using the DataReceivedEvent ).
